name: HeroBanner
description: Full-bleed hero image with a display headline and an optional overlapping search widget.

provenance.tag: Live (Heroic-Medium 120px hero headline). Font falls back per D7.

rules: Media ratio="21:9" radius="none" overlay="bottom-gradient" + Text variant="display-xl" + optional search widget overlap.
display-xl applies from lg; below lg the headline uses display-lg.

ambiguities.description: Live uses the proprietary Heroic-Medium font for the hero; this system uses the base stack (D7). The Media ratio for heroes (21:9) is Rec.
